label: The comparative ameliorating effects of an amorphous formula of curcumin and α-glycosyl isoquercitrin on hippocampal dysfunction in a rat gulf war illness model.
summary: Brain dysfunction is a primary symptom of Gulf War illness (GWI). The present study investigated the effects of an amorphous formula of curcumin (CUR) and α-glycosyl isoquercitrin (AGIQ) on neurobehaviors and adult neurogenesis and following synaptic plasticity of produced neurons in the hippocampal dentate gyrus (DG) in a rat GWI model.
